title: ajuga iva var. cleistogama
intro: Ajuga iva var. cleistogama, commonly known as Bugleweed or Ajuga, is a flowering plant in the mint family Lamiaceae. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and insomnia due to its sedative and calming effects, as well as its ability to help regulate blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Ajuga iva var. cleistogama include being an antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, making it useful for treating conditions such as epilepsy, fever, and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include ajugan, ajugol, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
